Weed in SoHo

SoHo and Nolita have four licensed dispensaries with about 1,580 products. The Travel Agency on Broadway near Houston is the largest at about 660, Alta on Kenmare Street on the Nolita side lists about 430, The Flowery's SoHo store on Broadway near Broome lists about 300, and Dagmar on West Broadway is a 190-item pre-roll shop. All four are within a ten-minute walk of each other.

This is the only Manhattan neighborhood where edibles are the largest category, at 433 listings, with 391 pre-rolls, 362 vapes and 282 flower options. The 30 topicals are the second-most of any neighborhood, driven by Alta's 18-item shelf, and tinctures total 27. The Travel Agency carries one of the deepest Ruby Farms runs in the city and a strong Camino and Wyld selection; Alta is the MFNY and 1906 stop. Prices start at $3.50 for 1906 pouches at Alta and $9 for 5 Boro dime bags at The Travel Agency. For shoppers on Broadway, The Travel Agency and The Flowery are a few blocks apart on the same street.

Good to know
  • Four licensed shops: The Travel Agency (about 660 products), Alta (about 430), The Flowery SoHo (about 300) and Dagmar West Broadway (about 190).
  • Edibles (433) are the largest category, unusual for Manhattan; 30 topicals is the second-most in the city.
  • The Travel Agency is the full-menu stop; Alta has the largest topical shelf we track.
  • Entry prices are $3.50 at Alta and about $5 elsewhere.
SoHo FAQ
What is the largest dispensary in SoHo?

The Travel Agency at 598 Broadway near Houston Street, with about 660 products. It is the biggest licensed menu between 14th Street and the Financial District.

Where can I buy cannabis topicals in SoHo?

Alta on Kenmare Street, which lists 18 topical products, more than any other licensed dispensary we track. Balms, lotions and patches with THC, CBD or both are all represented.

Is Dagmar West Broadway worth a stop?

For a quick pre-roll or gummy, yes. Pre-rolls are 82 of its 190 listings, with Heady Tree and Stone Road stocked. For vapes or flower, Alta and The Travel Agency carry far more.
